rf: RF is a substance produced by the hypothalamus that is capable of accelerating the secretion of a given hormone by the anterior pituitary gland.
RF can also mean a radioactive transuranic element which has been synthesized.
RF can also mean a complex neural network in the central core of the brainstem.
RF means the same as releasing factor or releasing hormone or rutherfordium.
rfd: RFD is free government delivery of mail in outlying country areas.
RFD means the same as rural free delivery.
